name: Haas ST-25Y (Classic Control)
description: Y-axis turning centre with live tooling and a C axis, Haas Classic (pre-NGC) control. Diameter-programmed X. The 2D preview draws the X-Z turning path; Y-axis and C-axis live-tool work is listed but not drawn.
sources: Haas ST-25Y published specification: X 8.4 in (213 mm), Y +/-2.0 in (+/-50.8 mm), Z 22.5 in (572 mm) travels, rapids 472 / 472 / 945 ipm (12 / 12 / 24 m/min), 3400 rpm spindle, 12-station turret, C axis
Haas Lathe Operator's Manual (Classic Haas Control) G-code chapter: one-block G71/G72/G73/G74/G75/G76 canned cycles

kinematics.description: Z carriage along the spindle axis, X cross-slide (radial), turret on the cross-slide; the C axis turns the chuck and workpiece. Preview coordinates are X radius and Z along the spindle.
